profile_registry: 共享/运营/SOP/生图风格档案.json

tasks.purpose: 把已选图书馆学习照片整理为本文的微信横封面，同时保留真实、日常的开学学习场景。

final_stage.content_prompt: Crop the supplied photograph to a wide WeChat article cover. Use only pixels already present in the input photograph. Keep the full original width and remove only top and bottom portions as needed. Do not outpaint, extend, reconstruct, redraw, retouch, enhance or synthesize any part of the image.
preserve: The same student, face, glasses, pose, writing hand, notebook, laptop, desk lamp, table, library interior, warm light, colors and photographic texture
The student and laptop must both remain recognizable inside the central cover-safe area
output_constraints: Wide horizontal WeChat cover composition, approximately 2.35:1
Readable at small mobile cover size
Do not turn the photograph into an illustration or a newly staged scene
avoid: Adding, removing, replacing, retouching or restyling people and objects
Changing identity, facial features, hands, clothing, laptop stickers, lighting or location
Logos added by the model, watermarks, captions, headlines, garbled text or fake interfaces
